title: A fork pull request does not fail the label job, a symlinked session is not read, and a matching stage label is not recreated.
description: A fork pull request does not fail the label job, a symlinked session is not read, and a matching stage label is not recreated.
acceptance_criteria: A fork pull request skips the label job. A symlinked session.md is not read. An existing label is created only when it is missing, and --force is used only when its color or description differs. implement and verify are deleted only when they exist.

answers.constraints: tasks.md has no unchecked boxes. An approved delta stays frozen. The checkout pin stays the commit ci.yml uses.
